component.name: PlasmaZones Layout Editor
component.summary: Create and edit zone layouts and scrolling templates

description.p: The PlasmaZones Layout Editor is the visual companion to the PlasmaZones window placement system for KDE Plasma. Use it to author named zone layouts, drag zone boundaries on a live canvas, configure per-zone appearance, and pick the layout that should activate on each monitor. It also edits the scrolling templates that set the starting columns of a strip.

ul.li: Drag-to-resize zones with snap-to-grid and zone-mirror tools
Fixed-geometry and relative-geometry zones for resolution-independent layouts
Import / export layout JSON for sharing
Starting columns and size presets for scrolling templates
